blocks.text: Set up Google Sheets as a Mac app

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac app. You can build your own using Chrome. Open your sheet in Chrome, then go to the three-dot menu at the top right. Select Save and Share, then choose Install page as app. This creates an icon in your Applications folder that opens Sheets in its own window.
Master keyboard shortcuts for rent rolls

Speed is vital when you are reviewing a large rent roll. Press ⌘ + / to see the full list of shortcuts. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace outdated tenant names or unit numbers. If you need to hide rows that contain irrelevant data, use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9. This keeps your view clean.
Reduce time spent on data preparation

Analysts spend about 80 percent of their time cleaning data. Stop doing this manually. Use formulas like UNIQUE to identify duplicate property records or filter functions to isolate specific asset classes. If a file is too messy, import the CSV and use the built-in split text features to organize headers correctly.

items: Hard-coding values instead of referencing cells for flexible underwriting.
Ignoring error messages like #REF! that indicate broken links in your model.
Overloading a single sheet with too many complex tabs and scripts.
Sharing files with edit access when you only need to show the data.
Working in multiple browser tabs which causes memory lag on your Mac.

blocks.text: Optimize your Mac for financial analysis

Keep your Mac running smoothly by closing unused browser tabs. If you use many sheets, use Mission Control to switch between them quickly. Keep your most used files in a dedicated folder in Finder. This reduces the time you spend searching for the right underwriting model.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no native app. You can create a web app shortcut in Chrome to get a similar experience.

faq.question: How do I fix formula errors in my real estate model?
faq.answer: Check your cell ranges and ensure your data types match. Use the built-in error checking by clicking the cell with the error.

faq.question: What is the limit for data in one sheet?
faq.answer: You can have up to 20 million cells in a single spreadsheet.
